purpose: Retrieval and future fine-tuning sources for a philosophical, historically careful, Linux-literate Vesper profile.
policy: Only ingest text whose source terms permit the intended use. Store URL, title, access date, license or permission note, and a content hash for every downloaded artifact. Do not scrape arbitrary copyrighted web pages.

sources.title: Project Gutenberg Philosophy collection
sources.license_note: Project Gutenberg hosts many public-domain works, but each ebook's header and Project Gutenberg license terms must be checked individually before redistribution or training use.

sources.title: Internet History Sourcebooks Project
sources.license_note: The site describes its collection as public-domain and copy-permitted material, while also warning that some translations are not necessarily copyright-free. Ingest only entries whose page-level permission is clear.

sources.title: GNU Operating System and Free Software Movement
sources.license_note: GNU pages identify their page-level licenses; preserve attribution and license notices. The homepage is CC BY-ND 4.0, so do not create modified redistributions of those page texts without checking the license implications.

sources.title: Linux kernel documentation
sources.license_note: Kernel materials carry file-specific SPDX identifiers and GPL-2.0 or compatible terms. Preserve SPDX metadata and do not assume every file has identical terms.

sources.title: SPDX License List
sources.license_note: Use SPDX identifiers to validate and record source licenses during ingestion.
